title: Add privacy-safe PWA shell and accessible, resilient preview flows
head: feat/private-product-execution
body:
The application lacked installable/offline PWA behavior, modal keyboard lifecycle and a visible active F01 timeout. Add an integrity-bound static-only shell with safe updates and explicit degraded states, accessible dialogs/profile controls/reflow, and request-owned timeout/retry behavior. Guard both Pages jobs against manual publication from integration/feature refs.

Validated application source c185132: both builds/typechecks;91calculation+102boundary tests; independent actual Chromium PWA root/project/alternate, keyboard/reflow and timeout suites; fresh read-only nonroot Node22 container worker/MIME/CSP/cache smoke; existing desktop/mobile checkout/timing browser regressions. The bounded historical smoke passes50checks/20requests at1VU, with no capacity claim. Source and final packet have independent scoped PASS reports.

Full private readiness remains NO-GO. Complete approved matrix/CERS/ASCR, domain/reference methods and actual device/UAT/workload/private-host evidence remain unresolved. Synthetic install controls and accelerated versioned-worker update tests are explicitly distinguished from actual OS install and normal polling. Production/live-payment restrictions are preserved. No main merge/deployment performed.

See docs/release/delivery/READINESS.md, TRACEABILITY.json, STATE.json, HANDOFF.md and RUNBOOK.md. Target integration only; required exact-head CI/review and configured repository controls still govern integration. Do not use this PR as owner approval or full-product/scientific acceptance.
